description: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) across different TFLOPs values for five model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis represents Loss Ratio (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 94% to 100%. The "Vanilla" model, shown with a purple dashed line and triangle markers, maintains a constant loss ratio of 100% across the entire TFLOPs range. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model, depicted with an orange dashed line and circle markers, starts at approximately 98.3% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to about 99.9% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model, shown with a blue dashed line and cross markers, begins at approximately 97.1% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to about 99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model, represented by a green dashed line with diamond markers, starts at approximately 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs and rises to about 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model, shown with a red dashed line and circle markers, begins at 94% at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to approximately 98.9% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
